svg.text: YOU CAN'T AMPLIFY A PROCESS THAT ISN'T RUNNING.
— the article everyone wants to skip. build the base before you buy the margin.
POWER-ON SEQUENCE · INTERLOCKED · build runs in ONE order
≈ 1 week · the big lever · must complete first
amp gets its enable only here
BEHAVIOUR FIRST · PERFORMANCE SECOND · HARDWARE THIRD
run it in any other order and you're amplifying a problem.
[ STAGE 1 · DRAIN THE BASELINE ] the hero — dopamine works on CONTRAST
greyscale the phone: strips the visual reward.
not laziness; the bar is too high.
CLOSE THE VALVES → OPEN THE DRAIN
the fix is not willpower — it's draining the level
that flatness IS the baseline draining.
boredom = sensitivity returning, not a failure state.
lower the floor so real work clears it.
[ STAGE 2 · ATTACH REWARD TO REAL WORK (± STIMULANT) ]
added here, it lifts real work on a system primed to receive it.
✗ OUT OF ORDER — THE ONE FAULT
JITTERS, NOT FOCUS — a stimulant on an un-drained baseline.
elevated heart rate, almost none of the focus — the receptors aren't there to receive it.
does nothing acutely — that's why it comes last, on an already-running system.
reward pulse on the RISING EDGE
coffee made ONLY when you sit to write → cue pulls you in
PROTECT THE CONTRAST · needs a low baseline
the same circuit already wrote 'dip → open IG → reward' — it strengthens whatever you pair reward with.
all five must read GREEN to energize the bus.
any toggle amber/red → the bus stays LOCKED.
a compound here is money spent masking a problem
THE BASE IS NOT THE BORING
the module you keep reaching for
is the last one that turns on.
drain the floor · build the supply · then add the margin
THE POWER SUPPLY · FIVE FREE INPUTS · DELIBERATELY UNEQUAL GAUGE
not accessories — the actual supply the whole board runs on. a starved supply browns out everything.
thickest primary feed · upstream of all
three levers broken for free. the Sleep series is Part 0 of this one.
a dynamo · neurogenesis you can't buy
2 of 3 materials — the wall won't build.
treat fish oil like creatine; take
the only floor worth raising is the one income + sleep + health lift UNDER you — not the one cheap hits inflate ABOVE you.
income → buys better sleep + food → feeds body & brain → raises the floor it started UNDER you
YOU OUT-BUILD A DEFAULT. YOU DON'T OUT-THINK IT.
a compound is a thought-substitute; a built default is the lever.
